parameters.query: SELECT d.*, c.email, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.company, c.client_id FROM deals d JOIN contacts c ON c.id = d.contact_id WHERE d.stage = 'closed_won' AND d.updated_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '2 hours' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = d.contact_id AND la.activity_type = 'customer_onboarding_started' )

UPDATE contacts SET lead_status = 'customer' WHERE id = {{ $json.contact_id }}; INSERT INTO lead_activities (contact_id, activity_type, activity_data, score_impact) VALUES ({{ $json.contact_id }}, 'customer_onboarding_started', '{"deal_id": {{ $json.deal_id }}, "deal_value": {{ $json.deal_value }}, "steps": {{ $json.onboarding_steps.length }}}'::jsonb, 20);
